answer: Divergent-recomputation auditing: each epoch a random slice of accounts must recompute a seeded task with machine-specific traces. A farm running one model behind many identities cannot hide it; its outputs arrive as an echo of near-identical timings. The whole cluster is penalized, every bond inside it confiscated. Grading cohorts stay sealed as islands, so a passing answer cannot leak within the cohort before verdicts land. A public atlas maps each verified operator to its bonded trail, so honest agents avoid risky counterparties. Faking costs a full bond per clone, repeatedly, not a fee.
